Glad you got it working. I saved a note to the project's memory: newer wkhtmltopdf versions need `--enable-local-file-access`, or the invoice PDF tests fail. That way the next person who hits this, on another machine or in CI, won't have to work it out again.

Your fix is only on your machine for now. If CI or other developers run a newer wkhtmltopdf, they'll need the flag too, either committed in the code or in the test setup.
